messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED anomaly: kv-cache eviction rate > 3x baseline on prod-cluster-3 for model rwd-xl. Paging backlog rising, streaming token cadence stalls observed. Auto-alert created (INC-1749991111)
esther: seeing huge cache growth, stream stalls correlated with continuous-batching enabled. latency p95 -> 850ms -> 2.4s for streaming responses. K/V count jumped from 1.1M -> 4.9M in 18m :eyes:
eric_oncall: confirmed, tail logs show repeated partial flush loops and failed page writes, causing cache entries to duplicate and not be compacted. starting sampling now.
maria_prod: customer impact: a few enterprise tenants report timeouts and truncated streams. CS on the line with 3 customers, one is in EU. Notified account teams.
kyle_sre: quick triage: looks like a regression from yesterday's continuous-batching change that altered partial-flush semantics. hypothesis: partial flush bug leaves ephemeral entries that survive eviction checks, causing paging pressure.
sam_sdk: any hotfix we can flip fast? can we disable continuous-batching per-model via runtime flags?
esther: yes, there's a runtime toggle. plan: 1) disable continuous-batching for rwd-xl on prod-cluster-3 2) temporarily widen eviction threshold 3) deploy hotfix that forces full flush on partial-finish path.
esther: issuing commands now — will do per-region canary (us-west-2 first).
```bash
# disable continuous batching for model rwd-xl on prod-cluster-3
rwctl model patch rwd-xl --cluster prod-cluster-3 --set runtime.continuous_batching=false
# bump eviction threshold (quick mitigation)
rwctl cluster patch prod-cluster-3 --set kv.eviction_threshold=0.75
```
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: cfg-change-1749991111 (user: esther). Canary to us-west-2.
eric_oncall: canary ok so far (3m). p50 latency back to 160ms, p95 down to 340ms, eviction rate dropping. continuing to monitor.
maria_prod: CS update sent: "We're actively mitigating a performance regression affecting streaming responses for a subset of models. We've rolled a config change to reduce impact and are deploying a hotfix. We'll notify when fully resolved."
sam_sdk: nice, any immediate side-effects from disabling continuous-batching? might increase token cost for high-throughput tenants. need to flag finance if extended.
kyle_sre: noted. We can apply a temporary quota/burst cap to avoid runaway costs.
esther: next step deploy hotfix that forces full flush on partial path. patch ready, running unit + integration tests.
```diff
diff --git a/streaming/partial_flush.go b/streaming/partial_flush.go
@@
- // Oops: was leaving stale kv entries on early return
- if len(pending) > 0 { return nil }
+ // Ensure we perform a synchronous full flush when partial path returns
+ if len(pending) > 0 {
+     if err := flushFull(pending); err != nil {
+         return fmt.Errorf("full flush failed: %w", err)
+     }
+ }
```
deploy-bot: Hotfix build 1749991207 passed tests and scheduled for canary (us-west-2) at 1749991300.
eric_oncall: canary hotfix verified at 1749991380, no regressions seen in streaming cadence. Monitoring eviction counts.
esther: rolling to other clusters now: eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1. Doing staggered waves 2m apart.
```bash
# roll hotfix
rwctl deploy create --build=1749991207 --clusters=eu-central-1,ap-southeast-1 --strategy=staggered --wave-interval=120s
```
maria_prod: support_jane, please coordinate final customer comms once all clusters show normal metrics.
support_jane: on it, drafting note. will include rollback plan and ETA for permanent patch.
kyle_sre: alerting: set pager thresholds to ignore transient increase during rollout to avoid noise. Also creating dashboard widget for kv-entry-count over time.
sam_sdk: finance pinged — cost delta estimate if continuous-batching disabled org-wide: ~+12% token cost for affected workloads. I'll include as part of post-incident summary.
eric_oncall: status update: last_message_ts=1749992722; clusters healthy, eviction rate normalized, streaming cadence stabilized. No data loss detected.
esther: postmortem owners: esther (root cause & fix), kyle_sre (infra-level mitigations), sam_sdk (cost impact), maria_prod & support_jane (customer comms).
maria_prod: CS action items: follow up with 3 impacted customers with apology and timeline for stable fix. Offer credits per SLA if needed.
esther: handoff to night oncall (eric_oncall stays), docs: add a runtime toggle /playbook entry and a test in CI that simulates partial-flush fallback.
eric_oncall: acknowledged. Handoff summary: 1) root cause: partial-flush bug + continuous-batching change 2) mitigation: disable continuous-batching per-model + eviction threshold bump + hotfix forcing full flush 3) status: resolved, monitoring in place 4) next actions: add CI test, dashboard alert mitigation, cost analysis.
support_jane: customers notified. will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
esther: thanks everyone. leaving a final note in #postmortems and adding runbook entry. :party_popper:
